senses.gloss:
Kabīraśataka
on the significance of the name an. attributes of Kabīr(das) ascribed to Pātālakhaṇḍa of Brahmayāmalatantra.
Pt.. with Hindi metrical paraphrase by Akhairam, Banaras, 1901. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 716.

Kabīraikottaraśataka
discussion on the greatness of the name Kabir.
Pt.. with Hindi metrical transl. Veṅk. Press, Bombay, 1905. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1202.

Kabīropāsanāpaddhati
of the Kabir panthis; by Makan-jī Kubera Painter. Includes [Page156-b] several Skt. hymns. Pt.. Bombay, 1904. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 604.
